title: Dual-mode N4O3 tripodal hemi-salen Schiff base sensor for selective colorimetric detection of Ni2+ and fluorometric sensing of Zn2+: analytical applications across food, environmental, and forensic matrices
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25675-25695
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01601D, Paper
Open Access

Dishen Kumar, Srishti Dutta, Rajat Kumar Roy, Devanand Sahu, Abhilash Pandey, Vanshika Sharma, Anjali Suryavanshi, Goutam Kumar Patra
The tripodal N4O3 donor tris-Schiff base hemi-salen molecular probe L have been presented here for sensitive and selective colorimetric detection of Ni2+ and turn-on fluorometric detection of Zn2+ in aqueous medium.
